dedupe_keys.name: cms healthcare provider cost reporting information system hcris cost report data

description: HCRIS holds the annual cost reports that every Medicare-certified institutional provider in the United States must submit. For hospitals the reports give facility characteristics, bed counts and utilisation such as patient days and discharges by unit, costs and charges by cost centre, Medicare settlement data and financial statements; parallel files cover skilled nursing facilities, home health agencies, renal dialysis facilities, hospices, health clinics, federally qualified health centres, rural health clinics, community mental health centres and organ procurement organisations. The producer is the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services, which receives the reports through Medicare Administrative Contractors. Coverage is national at provider level, with hospital data from fiscal year 1996 to 2026. Licence (read on the provider page on 2026-09-28): U.S. Government Works (catalog.data.gov licence: usa.gov/government-works). Caveats: the files are relational tables keyed by worksheet, line and column, so extraction needs the form documentation; reporting periods differ between providers; recent years are incomplete until reports are settled; several older forms are no longer updated. Simulation uses: bed capacity, occupancy and staffing baselines for hospital surge and resilience models, and cost parameters for evaluating investments in resilient healthcare facilities. Related records: the CMS Provider Data Catalog for hospitals (data-cms-provider-data-hospitals) gives quality and timeliness measures for the same providers. Access is through the provider page linked in this record.
